Vsync on and off both present; tearing was allowed with sync interval 0 on this machine. Every run exited 0. The frame graph's plan for each presented frame is scene, blit, readback, then 'present sync 1'.

results.c2_hardware: on the RTX 4090 (no WARP): two presented runs of 600 frames and the offscreen run give 600 of 600 equal hashes, and the offscreen list equals the WARP list of evidence/n2-warp/offscreen.json 600 of 600: the frames are the same on WARP, lavapipe, SwiftShader and the RTX 4090.

mistakes_found_on_the_way: The first lifecycle run failed to recover: the host passed an error string that already held the loss message into D3d12Device::init, which reports success as an empty string, so a good new device read as a failure. Fixed in the host (a fresh string) and in rhi::createDevice (its own string).

With the debug layer on, the process ended with exit code 0x87D at teardown: the swapchain was released while its last Present was still queued. The swapchain now drains the queue before a resize or a release.

While removing temporary trace lines, a sed over src/ deleted two lines of src/rhi/d3d12/hw_rayquery.cpp that contained the word TRACE (PREFER_FAST_TRACE). Caught in git status before the commit and restored from git; not in any commit.
does_not_prove: Anything about a hardware adapter except what the queued RTX run will record; what the compositor or the panel shows; recovery from a real driver fault, since WARP removal is triggered by the API.
